description: Compute a one-shot status summary for a PR: state, risk score (and whether it describes the current head), CI state for the head commit as the merge gate sees it, AI-review verdicts (trio), gate signals, auto-merge (armed? `last_attempt.reason` says what it waits for or what happens next), and `mergeTrain.lastDequeue` — the merge train's newest receipt for a green merge preview it did not merge (which commit, which runs, why). Read-only.
name: gluecron_pr_status_summary
